_about: Deliberate rests: stretches where the ball may be motionless for more than 0.6 s without tools/ball_speed.py --contacts flagging it PARKED (docs/ball-character.md, 'Checks'). Each entry: chapter, room (as ball_speed names it), from and to in Finesse-panel seconds (the loop's first pass: the intro is 0 to 3.2, the loop starts at 3.2; a rest that runs across the loop's seam may end after the loop's end), why (the moment it is for: the gather before a big move, the beat before a reveal, hidden inside an object), and who approved it and when. Keep rests short and few; a rest is a choice, not a default. They live here, not as comments in scene.rml, because a rive pull rewrites scene.rml and drops comments.
